# Email: Raw Multi-Recipient

💳 Curated by Skill Harbor — the raw multi-recipient email extension for Caffeine AI apps: one call (`sendRawEmail`) sends the same email with full `to` / `cc` / `bcc` fields, up to 50 recipients total — meeting reminders, announcements, anything where recipients see each other. Depends on `caffeinelabs-extension-email` for the underlying send. Requires a Caffeine AI Plus or Pro subscription — there is no free tier for this skill. Distinct from `caffeinelabs-extension-email` (one individual email per recipient): this one is explicitly for visible multi-recipient mail. By @caffeinelabs, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: works only inside a Caffeine AI build (Internet Computer canister + Motoko); the skill itself warns against using this for bulk service mail — recipients see each other, which is normally a privacy breach; use the individual-send skill for that. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
